title: Som Tam (Papaya Salad) - Thai-Style
description: A spicy and sour salad made with shredded green papaya, tomatoes, chilies, and peanuts. This authentic Thai recipe is a staple in Thai cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large mortar and pestle, pound the chilies and garlic until well combined.
2. Add the peanuts and pound until crushed.
3. Add the shredded papaya and pound until slightly softened.
4. Add the diced tomatoes and pound until well combined.
5. Add the fermented fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, and som. Stir well.
6. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
7. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
8. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
